title: Braised Iberico Jamon with Spanish Pretzels
description: A rich, savory dish featuring Iberico jamon braised to perfection and served with crispy Spanish pretzels.
instructions: Brown the Iberico jamon slices in olive oil until crispy.
Transfer the browned jamon to a braising pan and add white wine, beef broth, garlic, and thyme.
Cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2-3 hours, or until the jamon is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Meanwhile, bake the Spanish pretzels in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Serve the braised jamon with the crispy pretzels on the side.
Garnish with fresh thyme, if desired.
